'''Frank Thielman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 St. Cloud tournament]] on 15 April 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court]] and Cloud City Sabacc, according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d550">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00d550/ st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-st-cloud-mn-java-z-4-15-00d550/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
